listings.name: Fremantle Remedial Massage Clinic
listings.blurb: A seven-day remedial clinic on Market Street covering deep tissue, sports and trigger-point work, pregnancy massage, cupping and lymphatic drainage. Prices are published plainly — thirty minutes from $70, an hour $130, concessions across the board — and HICAPS handles most health-fund rebates on the spot.
listings._source: fremantlemassage.com.au — address, phone, email, full price list, hours, HICAPS confirmed

listings.name: Subiaco Sports Massage & Physio
listings.blurb: A Rokeby Road institution pairing sports and remedial massage with physiotherapy, dry needling, cupping and pilates — reformer classes included. Open early to 8pm on weekdays with weekend hours, and a South Perth recovery annexe with saunas and cold plunges for the training crowd.
listings._source: subisportsmassage.com — address, phone, email, services, hours confirmed; prices behind a pricing page

listings.name: Life Wellness Massage Therapy
listings.address: Unit 3, Level 1, 73 Hay St, Subiaco WA 6008
listings.blurb: A six-room Hay Street studio with a large therapist team working across deep tissue, remedial, sports and relaxation massage, plus lymphatic drainage, reflexology-style foot work and mobile visits. A registered health provider, so most private funds rebate through HICAPS.
listings._source: lifewellnessmassage.com — address, phone, services, health-provider status confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Joondalup Drive Therapeutic Massage
listings.blurb: A quiet northern-suburbs clinic whose range runs wider than most: remedial, relaxation and pregnancy massage alongside hot stone work, Bowen therapy and manual lymphatic drainage — two modalities that are genuinely hard to find north of the river. Weekday and Saturday hours, booked online.
listings._source: jdtmassage.com.au — address, phone, email, services, hours confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Victoria Park Sports Massage & Acupuncture Clinic
listings.blurb: Sports and remedial massage alongside acupuncture, dry needling and laser therapy in a medical-centre suite off Orrong Road. First massage consultations open with a ten-minute assessment before hands go anywhere, and a mobile service covers people who can't come in.
listings._source: sportsmassagevicpark.com.au — address, phone, services confirmed; prices and hours not published

listings.name: Clear Mind Studio
listings.blurb: Massage across remedial, relaxation, pregnancy, hot stone and lymphatic drainage, with reiki and reflexology on the same menu and float tanks in the building. Hour-long sessions run $129–$159, evenings included most nights, and a membership from $95 a month suits people who treat it as maintenance rather than a treat.
listings._source: clearmindstudio.com — both addresses, phones, email, full price list, hours, membership confirmed

listings.name: The Remedy Kalamunda
listings.blurb: An eight-practitioner hills clinic led by senior therapist Hayley Davis, spanning remedial and sports massage, dry needling and physiotherapy through to naturopathy, EFT, clinical hypnotherapy and baby massage. The Midland rooms extend the same team down the scarp, with private-health rebates on eligible treatments.
listings._source: theremedykalamunda.com — both addresses, phone, email, team and services confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: BodyFix Clinic
listings.blurb: Remedial, sports and pregnancy massage with kinesiology and dry needling, working from rooms inside Feel Good Fitness on Reserve Drive. Most private health funds rebate on the spot through HICAPS, and booking runs online — one of the more complete hands-on therapy menus in the Peel region.
listings._source: bodyfixclinic.com.au — address, phone, services, HICAPS confirmed; prices and hours not published

listings.name: Wellbeing Physiotherapy
listings.address: Unit 11, 135-139 Cambridge St, West Leederville WA 6007
listings.blurb: Remedial massage inside a physiotherapy practice on Cambridge Street, with therapist Yoko Murai (Massage & Myotherapy Australia member) working 45, 60 and 90-minute sessions on deeper muscle tension and chronic tightness. Health-fund rebates process on site, and Saturdays are covered.
listings._source: wellbeingphysiotherapy.com.au — address, phone, email, therapist credentials, hours confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Mount Lawley Physiotherapy & Podiatry
listings.blurb: The massage arm of a long-standing Beaufort Street physio and podiatry practice: deep tissue, remedial, sports recovery, Swedish, pregnancy massage and myofascial cupping, with health-fund claiming for remedial work. Weekday evenings until 7pm and Saturday mornings make it workable around a job.
listings._source: mountlawleyphysioandpod.com.au — address, phone, email, services, hours, fund claiming confirmed; prices not published
